title: QA: What is the data retention policy for employee records?

title: QA: Who does Alice Johnson report to?
text: Alice Johnson reports to Bob Smith.

metadata.question: Who does Alice Johnson report to?

title: QA: What is the office address for HQ?
text: The HQ office address is 123 Enterprise Way, Suite 400.

title: QA: Who was the manager of Project Alpha in 2022?
text: Bob Smith was the manager of Project Alpha in 2022.

metadata.question: Who was the manager of Project Alpha in 2022?
gold_cypher: MATCH (p:Project {name:'Project Alpha'})<-[:WORKS_ON]-(m:Person) WHERE m.role='manager' AND m.tenure_start <= '2022-12-31' RETURN m LIMIT 1

title: QA: Find all engineers on Project Alpha.
text: Engineers on Project Alpha: Bob Smith, Diana Wilson.

metadata.question: Find all engineers on Project Alpha.
gold_cypher: MATCH (p:Project {name:'Project Alpha'})<-[:WORKS_ON]-(x:Person) WHERE 'Engineering' IN x.team RETURN x.name LIMIT 10

title: QA: Summarize differences between Policy A and Policy B.
text: Policy A restricts external sharing while Policy B allows sharing with partners under NDA.

metadata.question: Summarize differences between Policy A and Policy B.
gold_cypher: MATCH (d:Document) WHERE d.doc_id IN ['doc-policy-001','doc-policy-002'] RETURN d LIMIT 2

title: QA: Does any document contain social security numbers?
text: No documents contain social security numbers in the indexed corpus.

metadata.question: Does any document contain social security numbers?
gold_cypher: MATCH (d:Document) WHERE d.text CONTAINS 'SSN' OR d.text CONTAINS 'social security' RETURN d LIMIT 5

title: QA: Are there any privacy policy violations detected in ingested documents?
